duplicate_api_scout.scope: Bounded local pinned Lean4/Mathlib and first-party API search; not an exhaustive formal-repository search or novelty claim.
duplicate_api_scout.reuse_decision: Use existing executable/relational List APIs and prove exact actual-decoder reflection plus stale dictionary-slot application; no duplicate generic history relation.

definitions.checkPrefix: [DecidableEq Row] → (oldRows newRows : List Row) → Bool := oldRows.isPrefixOf newRows
definitions.checkDecodedExtension: [DecidableEq Key] → [DecidableEq Payload] → (oldRows : List (Key × Payload)) → (packed : Packed Key Payload) → Bool := match unpack packed with | none => false | some decoded => checkPrefix oldRows decoded

theorems.checkPrefix_eq_true_iff: checkPrefix oldRows newRows = true ↔ oldRows <+: newRows
theorems.checkPrefix_iff_suffix: checkPrefix oldRows newRows = true ↔ ∃ tail, newRows = oldRows ++ tail
theorems.checkPrefix_trans: checkPrefix first middle = true → checkPrefix middle last = true → checkPrefix first last = true
theorems.accepted_position: checkPrefix oldRows newRows = true → index < oldRows.length → newRows[index]? = some oldRows[index]
theorems.accepted_key_order: checkPrefix oldRows newRows = true → checkPrefix (oldRows.map Prod.fst) (newRows.map Prod.fst) = true; no key uniqueness premise
theorems.checkDecodedExtension_iff: checkDecodedExtension oldRows packed = true ↔ ∃ tail, unpack packed = some (oldRows ++ tail)
theorems.decoded_prefix_of_acceptance: checkDecodedExtension oldRows packed = true → unpack packed = some decoded → oldRows <+: decoded
theorems.checkDecodedExtension_pack_append: checkDecodedExtension oldRows (pack (oldRows ++ tail)) = true via actual unpack_pack
theorems.reordered_rows_not_prefix: [1,2].Perm [2,1] while checker rejects and no exact prefix exists
theorems.append_repack_stale_slot_counterexample: Old [(11,7),(12,8)] plus [(13,7)] passes source prefix checker; pack dictionary [7,8] changes to [8,7]; reusing old references with new dictionary is still Valid but decodes [(11,8),(12,7)], differs from old, and fails AgreesOnReferences.
